comment.name: Millard J Melnyk
comment.body:
That's it. From now on I'm calling out anyone who claims that the violence of war and human sacrifice is rooted in "human nature" as an ignorant ass blower or a noxious, malicious liar -- just like I would someone who defamed and degraded my sweetheart.

So would you, too, if you had any genuine love for humanity.

Of all the prehistoric artwork we've discovered, less than 1% of it depicts war or ritualized violence like human sacrifice, and virtually all of those depictions date AFTER the advent of agriculture and the practice of land ownership that gave rise to what we so perversely call "civilization".

All this butt bloviation about the innate violence of the whole of the homo sapiens species has been based on a statistically negligible set of data concerning human activity of the last 10,000 years, which amounts to less than a half hour of the entire human day.

What's more, it denies the glaring fact that the overwhelming majority of human activity over the last 10,000 years has been peaceful. War and human sacrifice are entirely the responsibility of psychotic human beings who lust and obsess over this abomination they call "power", foment and justify revel in their psychoses as something "glorious", and get thousands and millions and billions whipped up into frenzies and trances to worship and serve their gods of mass murder, mass rape, mass deprivation, and mass devastation.

You fixate on the nature of psychotics and then generalize that to the whole of humanity. You're idiots.

Talk about gaslighting, holy shit.

The "violence rages in the human heart" crowd are ignorant assholes who don't even know how to think straight.

So all you people who pretend that human beings have a strong, natural, inborn bent towards violence need to get your heads examined, pay attention to facts instead of coddling your own brain farts, and learn how to think rationally -- because you're chock full of shit.

Or you're just fucking lying.

Violence lies in the heart of humans ONLY ONCE THEY'VE GONE MAD.

comment.body:
It's so disheartening that even the greatest minds never aspired to eradicating evil. The best that virtually everyone can imagine is holding it in check.

WHEN THE FUCK DO WE GET RID OF IT?

Every single argument I've examined that claims we cannot eradicate evil has been based on blind, fearful belief -- no evidence, no facts, no sound logic, no sane thinking. Terrified hysteria lies at the root of them all.

Unless the hysterical can be true, which is essentially a contradiction in terms, all that thinking amounts to bullshit.

Evil will be eradicated. The only question will be whether we contributed or not.

comment.name: Millard J Melnyk
comment.body:
Attributed to Keynes without substantiation, but the statement is representative of his thinking.

Keynes didn't consider the "astounding belief" as a mortal flaw for capitalism, but as reason for government regulation.

I see the belief as akin to trying to siphon drinking water from a cesspool, but I guess capitalists prefer their water stank and foul.

Keynes's thinking is a great example of the nonsense that people come up with when they go into working on an idea with preexisting commitments. If those commitments contradict what's really going on -- as capitalism and every other -ism certainly do -- then they end up coming round full circle to self-contradictions in the idea, like this "astounding" belief.

It's "astounding" because it's an obvious self-contradiction but capitalists refuse to admit it. So, in order to escape the problem, they (astoundingly) "just believe".

This is the same situation that cult beliefs eventually find themselves in if a person thinks them through honestly.

At that point of self-contradiction, we can admit the problem and realize that the idea is nonsense (as far as the self-contradiction goes), or we can become cultists and vindicate our preexisting commitments by embracing the nonsensical by means of an "astounding" leap of pseudo-faith.

Just like Keynes did.

Simply put, this “astounding belief” is a gigantic turd of bullshit: a con job.
